# MyLanguages.org

> > A comprehensive multilingual learning platform offering grammar lessons, vocabulary tables, pronunciation tools, and translation resources across 100+ languages including Arabic, Azerbaijani, Croatian, Basque, Chinese, Bengali, and Brazilian Portuguese.

MyLanguages.org provides structured language learning content organized by grammatical topics (pronouns, adverbs, negation, articles), practical vocabulary (basic words, phrases, questions), and multimedia resources (audio lessons, video tutorials). The site serves beginners and intermediate learners with translation tools, transliteration services, and cultural resources like Chinese calligraphy.

## Translation and Transliteration Tools

- [Arabic Translation](https://mylanguages.org/arabic_translation.php): Arabic-English translation tool and dictionary service
- [Arabic Transliteration and Romanization](https://mylanguages.org/arabic_transliteration.php): English to Arabic transliteration tool for names and text romanization

## Multimedia Learning Resources

- [Croatian Audio Lessons](https://mylanguages.org/croatian_audio.php): Downloadable Croatian MP3 audio lessons from 50languages.com
- [Arabic Video Lesson](https://mylanguages.org/arabic_video.php): Arabic video tutorial for comprehension and multimedia learning
- [Basque Video Lesson](https://mylanguages.org/basque_video.php): Basque (Euskara) video lesson for comprehension improvement

## Grammar Lessons: Pronouns and Articles

- [Brazilian Pronouns](https://mylanguages.org/brazilian_pronouns.php): Brazilian Portuguese pronoun types: personal, indefinite, reflexive
- [Azerbaijani Pronouns](https://mylanguages.org/azerbaijani_pronouns.php): Azerbaijani pronouns: personal, indefinite, relative, and reflexive
- [Croatian Articles](https://mylanguages.org/croatian_articles.php): Croatian definite and indefinite articles with food vocabulary tables

## Grammar Lessons: Adverbs and Negation

- [Croatian Adverbs](https://mylanguages.org/croatian_adverbs.php): Croatian adverbs: time, place, manner, and frequency with examples
- [Bengali Adverbs](https://mylanguages.org/bengali_adverbs.php): Bengali (Bangla) adverbs of time, place, manner, and frequency
- [Basque Negation](https://mylanguages.org/basque_negation.php): Basque (Euskara) negation grammar lesson with negative expressions
- [Berber Feminine](https://mylanguages.org/berber_feminine.php): Berber (Tamazight) grammatical gender: feminine and masculine forms

## Vocabulary and Common Phrases

- [Azerbaijani Vocabulary](https://mylanguages.org/azerbaijani_vocabulary.php): Azerbaijani (Azeri) vocabulary covering countries, colors, days & time
- [Danish Words](https://mylanguages.org/danish_words.php): Danish vocabulary list with common words and expressions (Dansk)
- [Belarusian Words](https://mylanguages.org/belarusian_words.php): Belarusian vocabulary list with basic words and translation tables
- [Brazilian Phrases](https://mylanguages.org/brazilian_phrases.php): Brazilian Portuguese common phrases: greetings, travel, daily expressions
- [Azerbaijani Questions](https://mylanguages.org/azerbaijani_questions.php): Azerbaijani interrogative expressions and question word grammar

## Optional

- [Chinese Calligraphy](https://mylanguages.org/calligraphy_ch.php): Free Chinese calligraphy service for names and custom text
